'''Walter Gilman (Chapter 5)''' is a special [[ally]] used in [[Welcome, Mr. Whateley]] of the 1st Arkham Spanish League.

==Card info==
*+1 [[Focus]]
*+1 [[Lore]]

The Investigator that has '''Walter Gilman''' as an [[ally]] cannot gain [[clue tokens]] in any way.

==Notes==
This is one of multiple versions of the Walter Gilman ally used by different scenarios.
